leggibili.consejo: Plural adjective of a single termination.

conservare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

texto: Look at the limits of the service: the operator assists and explains the procedures, but does not replace the citizen (**non compila le domande al posto dell'utente**).
Observe the conditions of access: **gratuito**, **su prenotazione**, and the reservation for solemn proceedings (**resta necessario presentarsi allo sportello tradizionale**).

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: public services and new technologies
Il nuovo sportello digitale del Comune

frases.it: Da lunedì il municipio apre uno sportello digitale per aiutare i cittadini a usare i servizi online.
frases.es: Desde el lunes el ayuntamiento abre una ventanilla digital para ayudar a los ciudadanos a usar los servicios online.
frases.en: Since Monday the city hall has opened a digital window to help citizens use online services.
analisis: from Monday the city hall opens

frases.it: L'operatore non compila le domande al posto dell'utente, ma spiega i passaggi necessari.
frases.es: El operador no cumplimenta las solicitudes en lugar del usuario, sino que explica los pasos necesarios.
frases.en: The operator does not comply with the requests instead of the user, but explains the necessary steps.
analisis: the operator does not comply with the applications

frases.it: Controlla inoltre che i documenti digitalizzati siano perfettamente leggibili.
frases.es: Comprueba además que los documentos digitalizados sean perfectamente legibles.
frases.en: It also checks that the digitized documents are perfectly legible.

frases.it: Il servizio è gratuito e funziona su prenotazione dal martedì al giovedì.
frases.es: El servicio es gratuito y funciona con cita previa de martes a jueves.
frases.en: The service is free of charge and works with a prior appointment from Tuesday to Thursday.
analisis: and works with a previous appointment

frases.it: Chi non ha un indirizzo email può crearne uno con l'assistenza dell'operatore.
frases.es: Quien no tiene una dirección de correo puede crear una con la ayuda del operador.
frases.en: A person who does not have an email address can create one with the help of the operator.
analisis: chi non ha un indirizzo email
with the help of the operator

frases.it: Per pratiche che richiedono una firma ufficiale, resta necessario presentarsi allo sportello tradizionale.
frases.es: Para trámites que exigen una firma oficial, sigue siendo necesario presentarse en la ventanilla tradicional.
frases.en: For procedures requiring an official signature, there is still a need to be presented at the traditional window.

bloques.pregunta: What is the primary objective of the new municipal service?

opciones.texto: Ayudar a los vecinos a utilizar con autonomía los servicios telemáticos oficiales.
opciones.explicacion: The text indicates: «per aiutare i cittadini a usare i servizi online».

opciones.texto: Fill in and sign all administrative requests on behalf of the neighbours.
opciones.explicacion: It is expressly clarified that the staff member does not comply with the user's requests.

opciones.texto: To replace all the traditional offices of the city in a definitive manner.
opciones.explicacion: The traditional front service is still operational for signature procedures.

bloques.pregunta: What specific work does the digital window operator do?

opciones.texto: Guide in the necessary steps and check that the scanned documents are read well.
opciones.explicacion: Explain the procedures and check that the «siano perfettamente leggibili» files.

opciones.texto: Keep the personal bank passwords of all taxpayers.
opciones.explicacion: It does not manage private financial keys.

opciones.texto: It costs a cash fee at the entrance to the room for each consultation.
opciones.explicacion: The service is totally free of charge.

bloques.pregunta: What does the indication of that «funziona su prenotazione» service mean?

opciones.texto: That it is essential to apply for a prior appointment to be taken care of on the days indicated.
opciones.explicacion: It requires an early shift reservation from Tuesday to Thursday.

opciones.texto: Only residents born in the municipality can attend.
opciones.explicacion: It does not discriminate by place of birth.

opciones.texto: That the attention is only provided by recorded video conference.
opciones.explicacion: The attention is provided physically in the municipal room with a concerted appointment.

bloques.pregunta: What option is offered to the citizen who has no e-mail?

opciones.texto: You can open a mail account with the operator's technical guidance.
opciones.explicacion: The text specifies: «può crearne uno con l'assistenza dell'operatore».

opciones.texto: It must give up any management before the public administration.
opciones.explicacion: It is provided with direct support to bridge the digital divide.

opciones.texto: Se le impone una sanción económica por carecer de medios informáticos.
opciones.explicacion: There is no penalty; access is made easier.

bloques.pregunta: In what circumstances is it still mandatory to go to the traditional window?

opciones.texto: When administrative proceedings require a hand-written signature or a face-to-face official.
opciones.explicacion: It is stipulated: «per pratiche che richiedono una firma ufficiale, resta necessario presentarsi».

opciones.texto: Whenever the user has a laptop and a own phone.
opciones.explicacion: In such cases, it can use the digital telematic track.

opciones.texto: Only on Friday afternoon when the building closes to the public.
opciones.explicacion: The traditional offices serve on their regular administrative hours.

bloques.pregunta: Why is this technical check essential?
bloques.frase: L'operatore controlla che i documenti digitalizzati siano perfettamente leggibili.

opciones.texto: To ensure that the attached files can be processed without reading errors.
opciones.explicacion: Legibility is an indispensable condition for the success of the file.

opciones.texto: To remove all documents not belonging to the transport undertaking.
opciones.explicacion: These are municipal citizens' efforts, not transport.

opciones.texto: Because the municipal system prohibits scanning black and white documents.
opciones.explicacion: Check the visual quality of the file, not the color.

bloques.frase: Per completare la pratica telematica, i documenti devono essere perfettamente ___.

opciones.texto: leggibili
opciones.explicacion: Plural adjective that is arranged with «documenti».

opciones.texto: leggibile
opciones.explicacion: It is the singular («un documento leggibile») form.

opciones.texto: letto
opciones.explicacion: It is the past participle of the verb leggere.

intro: Read this municipal statement about the opening of a digital service. It analyses the purpose of the initiative, the tasks assigned to the operator and the exceptions of face-to-face care.
